title: SINDH PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE SALE AND USE OF POLYTHENE BAGS ORDINANCE 2006

sections.shortTitle: SINDH PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE SALE AND USE OF POLYTHENE BAGS ORDINANCE 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2006
ORDINANCE I OF 2006
SINDH PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE, SALE AND USE OF POLYTHENE BAGS ORDINANCE, 2006
An Ordinance to prohibit; manufacture, sale and
use of black polythene bags including polythene bags below thirty micron
thickness in the Province
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-I, 1st
February, 2006]
No.
S.Legis:1(I)/2006, dated 1-2-2006.--The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient in the public interest to
prohibit, manufacture, sale, and use of black polythene bags including the
polythene bags below thirty micron thickness in the Province in the manner
hereinafter appearing and to provide for matters ancillary thereto;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor of Sindh
is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan the Governor of the Province
of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.--(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Prohibition on
Manufacture, Sale and Use of Polythene Bags Ordinance, 2006.
(2) This shall come
into force at once.

2. Definitions.---In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context---
(a) "factory" means
any premises where polythene bags are manufactured and produced;
(b) "Government" means the Government of the Sindh;
(c) "person"
includes shopkeeper, factory owner, hawker and any person associated with
manufacture or sale of polythene bags;
(d) "Polythene bag" means a leading product
of plastic prepared from polyethylene granules;
(e) "prescribed"
means prescribed by rules; and
(f) "rules" means
rules made under this Ordinance.

4. Penalty.---Any person who contravenes the provisions of
section 3, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three
months or with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees or with both:
Provided that if a
person convicted for an offence punishable under this section is again
convicted for such offence, the fine shall extend to one lac
rupees and the term of imprisonment shall extend to six months.

Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997.
